fields.why: Current cigarette smoking, binge drinking and heavy drinking are tobacco and alcohol use outcomes, so 'substance use' is defensible alongside 'health behaviors'; the article groups them under 'Behavior', which supports B's single label. Both readers quote the indicators accurately.

brief_issues: condition_group does not say whether tobacco and alcohol use measured as behavioral risk factors (BRFSS-style) go under 'substance use', 'health behaviors' or both; a rule (e.g. tobacco/alcohol use → substance use, with health behaviors reserved for physical activity, diet, sleep, screening) would decide it.
